$comment: Each public component x scenario: where a reader sees it, why it does not apply, or which slice owes it. Checked by src/__tests__/contracts/demo-scenarios.contract.test.ts against the demo pages' AST (src/test/demoScenarios.ts). A shown cell cites a section by its exact title, so editing a page around it does not make it stale; renaming the section does.

$vocabulary.shown: { page: the demo file, section: the <Section> title exactly } — the scenario's predicate must hold on that section
$vocabulary.na: { probe, reason } — probe is one of no-prop:<names>, no-name, no-async, imperative, overlay-content, not-focusable, inline-fixed, re-checked against the props walk
$vocabulary.gap: { reason, slice } — slice is D12a (forms), D12b (phone width), D12c (failing data), D12d (uncontrolled, long content) or D12e (composition), or a library slice (L24) where the demo waits on a library fix; fails once a section shows it

$basis: 2026-10-17, G6: from D12's hand-graded 660 cells, each re-checked by the predicates. 350 shown, 213 n/a, 97 gap; D12 had 364, 215 and 81. The 16 cells moved to gap: 12 `required` cells D12 graded without a <form>; InternationalPhoneInput long content (its only long list is its own) and TimePicker long content (the cited "Scroll Behavior" is about lockScroll); DatePicker and ResizablePanel long content, n/a in D12, where no fixed probe holds. 14 shown cells cite a different section from D12's line, because D12's line was outside any <Section> or its AST lacks the scenario. D12a, 2026-10-17: the 46 D12a cells are shown, by the In a form section on each form field page and Modal's Form in a modal (396 shown, 213 n/a, 51 gap). D12b, 2026-10-17: the 17 phone-width cells are shown, each by an At phone width section whose PhoneFrame loads the component's /preview route at 360 px (413 shown, 213 n/a, 34 gap). CascadingDropdown's stays a gap, owed by L24: its menu is wider than the viewport at that width. D12cd, 2026-10-17: 22 cells shown — the 6 failing cells by When loading fails sections on a loader that can reject (useFakeLoader), the 6 uncontrolled by Uncontrolled sections whose component holds its own value, and 10 of 12 long-content cells by Long labels sections (435 shown, 213 n/a, 12 gap). Checkbox's and Switch's long content stay gaps, owed by L24: their control shrinks beside a wrapped label.
